native_mechanisms: Fold one crease per mark, each crease angle set by both the mark and the preceding crease (feedback-chained accumulation, no look-ahead).

Test every crease against all four wire birds' beaks at once and refold tighter until all four agree (four parallel gauges plus a reject-and-refold agreement loop, deliberately scrambling positional alignment).
Thin the whole folded wad at the water's edge to one small dense coin and discard every scrap, offcut, and failed reading (irreversible terminal compression with no retained state).
core_technique: Verbatim xxHash64 (seed 0): four 64-bit lanes each running acc = rotl(acc + word*P2, 31) * P1 over 32-byte blocks, lane merge by rotate-add plus four mix rounds, length added, 8/4/1-byte tail folds, and a final xor-shift/multiply avalanche.
